title: Complete and harmonise the cross-border exchange requirements
requirements:
- Apply harmonised normative terminology and identify essential versus use-case-dependent requirements
- Present national-gateway federation as the preferred pattern in the examples while allowing other legally governed arrangements
- Consider a requirement for portable evidence identifying data, decision, governing model/version, actor and time
- Add emergency access, vulnerable populations and lawful exceptions
- Add data minimisation, purpose limitation, correction and redress across jurisdictions
